title: Where Are Dadi's Glasses? | Fun Kids Song & Nursery Rhymes | BuBu TV - English
description:
A silly search song where Dadi can't find her glasses, and the kids look everywhere in the fridge and under the sofa!
It teaches little ones to look carefully, check around them, and that the answer is sometimes right in front of us.
Sing along with the hop-hop-hop chorus and laugh together at the end!

Songs by BuBu TV - English

Look, look, where, where
Look, look, there, there
Hop, hop, hop, hop
Find the glasses, let's go!

Dadi says, "Where are my glasses?"
Where, where, where did they go?
Pat, pat, pat, pat
Oh, let's look all around!

Brother looks in the fridge, "Hmm, hmm,"
Little sis looks under the sofa, "Found it!"
Creak, creak, creak
No glasses there, oh dear!

Little sis sees them, "Ta-da, ta-da!"
Look up high, on Dadi's head
Ping, ping, ping, ping
Dadi, your glasses are there!

Dadi laughs, "Oh, silly me!"
Everyone laughs, "Ha, ha, ha!"
Ho, ho, ho, ho
Hooray, we found them, hooray!
